project.name: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Example
project.description: One exercise or more of every type: rewrite, translation, correction, essay, multiple choice, gap fill and flashcards.

content.instruction: Rewrite the sentence using the passive voice. Keep the meaning.
content.sourceText: Many cities have built new cycle lanes to reduce traffic.
content.modelAnswer: New cycle lanes have been built in many cities to reduce traffic.

content.instruction: Rewrite the paragraph in a more formal style. Replace informal words and join short sentences.
content.sourceText: Lots of people think social media is bad for kids. It takes up too much of their time, and they get stressed out about it. But I think it's not all bad, because kids can talk to friends and learn stuff online.
Ngày càng nhiều người trẻ chọn sống ở các thành phố lớn để có cơ hội việc làm tốt hơn.
Many student prefer online classes because it saves a time.

content.instruction: Some people think that governments should spend more money on public transport than on building new roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

content.question: If more people ____ public transport, city centres would be much less crowded.

options.explanationMarkdown: Present simple does not fit an unreal situation. The if-clause needs a past form.
Second conditional: if + past simple, would + verb.
*Would* belongs in the result clause, not in the if-clause.
*Although* introduces a contrast inside one sentence.

content.textWithGaps: Prices {{1}} sharply in recent years, so many families {{2}} to cut their spending.

gaps.explanationMarkdown: Present perfect for a change up to now.
Present perfect again: the result is still true now.
